svg.title: Modified LoongFlow Full-Agent Stack — editable vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Manually reconstructed from the supplied 1536 × 1024 reference. All labels are live SVG text. Panels, pictograms, branching graphs, connectors and arrowheads are separately editable vector objects. Text uses a Times-family serif font with natural, unstretched glyph proportions. No image, bitmap, embedded font, foreignObject, script, external reference or text outline is used.
